foreignObject.div: Figure 4. Peak interpreter RAM over 1,000 QuickDraw val programs. Buffering a path — the obvious port of the reference VM — costs 8 bytes per point, so it is a slope; streaming each point to the sink is a constant. On this corpus buffering peaks at ~1.2 KB and would fit, which is the honest reading: the design matters because the cost scales, not because it is large here. A 3 KB program of curves is ~7,000 points, ~56 KB, and no part in this class has that.
